title: Balloon PVP
description: When you have a balloon, you are granted the powers of creative mode. But if it touches the ground? You die...
body:
Balloons - they give huge power, allowing players to literally go into creative mode. But if it touches the ground? You die.

See the video of it in action: https://youtu.be/7ueDcsRzC_c

"Ground" is considered anything where the balloon thinks it's on the ground (that sounds stupid but it's based on entity data) and when the block directly below it's center is a solid block. This means balloons can float on walls, fences, and water just fine.

The resource pack and datapack are included in the download. Please read the "README.txt" file before you use it!

IMPORTANT: To get the items yourself, run the command "/function balloons:giveballoons" | There likely will be ways to obtain items individually in the future, but this should give you all relavant items.
